title: A Convergence-Guaranteed Algorithm for Stochastic Optimal Control Problems
summary: Stochastic Optimal Control Problems (SOCPs) plays a major role in the sequential decision-making challenges. There exist various iterative algorithms, under framework of stochastic maximum principle, that sequentially find the optimal control decision.
